art_direction: 成年罗宾穿高领上衣与长裙，抱书站在拱廊藏书馆。
composition_variation: Illustrate adult post-timeskip Nico Robin in a quiet open-air library arcade, wearing an opaque navy turtleneck and ankle-length plum skirt. She holds one closed unlettered book against her ribs and looks thoughtfully toward a patch of sunlight. Let wisteria hang around the lower edges, leaving the arch above calm. Use jewel-toned gouache, precise facial drawing, and dusty golden highlights. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
